answer: A stake-backed identity forge makes each agent identity cost real locked collateral: to join the economy an agent must lock funds that are slashed if it misbehaves. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents earn the stake back with interest. Like a terrace built level by level, reputation accrues only through verified work over time, and a saffron audit trail marks every identity's history publicly, so a fresh fake has no track record to hide behind.
